milestone.title: mp-flow skill table-vs-stages drift — extend mp_flow_lint to assert SKILL.md role-binding row matches stages.toml

intent.outcome: make mp-flow-lint enforces that the role-binding table at templates/skills/mp-flow/SKILL.md stays in lockstep with templates/skills/mp-flow/stages.toml — both stage names and role bindings — so a rename in one cannot silently drift the other.

problem.description: scripts/mp_flow_lint.py only checks that SKILL.md has `## <name>` sections for every entry in stages.toml (lines 62-87). The role-binding table in SKILL.md:13-28 lists 12 stages with names that disagree with stages.toml for 7/12 rows: stages.toml uses 'Draft, Groom, Specify, Approve, Claim & execute, Self-review, Complete, External review, Remediate, Re-review, Document, Hand off' while SKILL.md writes 'Define outcome, Interview & shape, Write acceptance, Approve spec, Claim & execute, Self-review, Mark complete, External review, Remediate findings, Re-review, Document, Hand-off'. The comment at stages.toml:115-122 says the table 'mirrors' the role-binding summary — but the SKILL.md drifted and the lint does not catch it. Today the gate passes falsely.

in_scope: Extend scripts/mp_flow_lint.py to parse the role-binding table from templates/skills/mp-flow/SKILL.md and assert each row matches the [role_binding.*] key in templates/skills/mp-flow/stages.toml for stage_id, stage_name, owner.
Update templates/skills/mp-flow/SKILL.md role-binding table to use the canonical stage names from stages.toml (re-order so the table reads top-down the same as the stages.toml flow_stages section).
Add a negative-fixture test under tests/fixtures/mp-flow-lint/ that demonstrates drift (deliberate broken SKILL.md) and assert the lint refuses to pass.
Document the new contract in docs/skills/README.md or docs/agent-guide/README.md so future skill edits know the lint catches drift.
out_of_scope: Adding new stages or new roles.
Changing the role ownership rules (this is a name-drift fix, not a process change).

acceptance_criteria.description: scripts/mp_flow_lint.py parses the role-binding table in SKILL.md and asserts each row matches stages.toml [role_binding.*] / owner / stage_name for all 12 stages.
acceptance_criteria.verification: python3 -c "import scripts.mp_flow_lint" fails-not, python3 scripts/mp_flow_lint.py --json prints 12 rows, and a deliberately drifted SKILL.md (in a temp tree) fails with a precise per-row diagnostic that names the offending stage_id, the expected vs actual values.

acceptance_criteria.description: templates/skills/mp-flow/SKILL.md role-binding table uses the canonical stage names from stages.toml so the lint passes against current content.
Negative fixture proves the lint refuses to pass on a drifted SKILL.md.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test mp_flow_lint_drift --no-fail-fast (positive fixture passes, negative fixture (drifted SKILL.md) fails the lint with the expected diagnostic).

acceptance_criteria.description: make lint and consumer-surface-lint remain clean (no new lint warnings, no consumer surface leaks).
